THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Ref. No.: IMDS/LND/05/ACQ/25/2005(13). I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose. Description of the Land or servitude to be acquired: Lot No. 161 (Lot 1) allotments below name land in Final Village Plan No. 563, Supplement No. 07 and dated 14.02.2011, prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys, Rathnapura District, situated in the village of Puwakgasarawa in the Grama Nilardhari Division of Kadawatha Korale Seelagama in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Imbulpe, in the District of Rathnapura in Sabaragamuwa Province. 1. Lot No. 161
Name of the Land: Udahawalauwewatta alias Puwak-gasarawegodawatta; Land use: Open waste land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: W. M. Kiribandara, Seelagama, Belihuloya; Extent: 0.0002 Hectares.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat, Imbulpe of the on 16th December 2016 at 9.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 02nd December 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude*, the amount of compensation and the details of the compensation of such amount. D. P. G. RENUKA, Divisional Secretary (Covering up)/ Land Acquiring Officer, Imbulpe - Rathnapura District. Divisional Secretariat, Imbulpe, 30th November, 2016. 12-797
